objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: So seems this construction guarantees at least 3/5.
objection.witness: Wrong final answer. The proposed c=(n+1)/(2n+1) is not achievable for n=2: with Liu's own suggested cuts (0.4,0.4,0.2), Xiang uses a SINGLE cut splitting the 0.2 piece into 0.1+0.1, giving pieces {0.4,0.4,0.1,0.1}; Liu then gets only 0.4+0.1=0.5 < 0.6. The parity-changing option of using fewer than n cuts is never analysed.
